text: F09 form test, decided before writing: a form, the first in this stage, scoped to a sequence and not a cause. Why it differs from F01 to F08: there the key added a step inside one element or restricted one clause, and the parts were shown in subsets of members; here the key is a link between two constructs of canvas organizing (P10, the move, and P03, building), and every member's line states that relation (53 of 55 specifications), with members' words. Constructs: P10, P03, with P04 (new coordinates, 14 members) as the usual means; condition: a loss or taken spot (11) or a site offered by others (6), rarely a judgment of too few hands (A10 restricted in 27); falsifiable by rooms that moved and did not build again (F-019 counts 11 that gave up). Shared status: supported as a sequence, local accounts unresolved. Not a finding (it bounds nothing); the missing arrow P10 to P03 goes to notes-D5.md for D6. Doubt carried: the relation is the cut, 10 lines disclaim cause, and selection may explain the higher kept rate (35 of 54 against 53 of 106 movers of similar size).

forms/F09-account.md written (6,473 words; 5,283 of prose in five parts, out/_analysis/d5a09_F09_part*.md; lists filled by d5_assemble.py: 54 unresolved members, the held proposals, 21 arrows, 96 cross-links). prose_check: 1 hit ('several sources'), reworded in the account and the part before the close; then 0. A bold lead-in in section 12 held the check's section-13 word; reworded before assembly. branches-D5.jsonl line 9 appended: form_or_grouping form, shared_status supported (as a sequence), binds information, over T4-012 and T4-014. Name defended (51 of 54 members). Members showed what the room notes did not predict: the move came from a taken spot, a loss or an offered site more than from a judgment of too few hands; a site given by another room's leave (6); a winning neighbour offering help to move (seolhyun).

D5a-09 closing. Section 1's arithmetic as declared at D5a-01; the logged rules and scripts with the tie rule of D5a-02 and the representative amendments of D5a-03, D5a-04 and D5a-06; construct_bindings hold construct ids only. The form test is judged as at D5a-09: a form needs a relation between constructs of canvas organizing stated across the members, not a step inside one element shown in subsets.
